definitions.Superiority: the upper bound of the 90% CI of ΔBS (candidate − incumbent) is below 0.
definitions.Non-inferiority at +5%: the upper bound is below 0.05 × the incumbent's BS on the same rows.

primaries.ci: 90% storm-block bootstrap (B = 2000, seed 0); Δ = candidate − incumbent

rows.label: S1
rows.comparison: NWP model vs served ICON: either-wet MAE, lead 1, two-gauge mean
rows.rule: the CI of ΔMAE excludes 0. A weather model is chosen on S1 only.
rows.reason: the candidate reads the served weather model (icon_seamless): S1 is set-independent (stages_s1); its gauges' dead days read gauge_outage_v2, days S1's grade leaves out (X-S1-OUTAGE)

rows.label: S2
rows.comparison: candidate vs served component, basin-pooled ΔBS, within one geography
rows.window: T2 (nested for new choices), confirmed on T1 post
rows.rule: superiority on T2; non-inferiority at +5% on T1 post
rows.reason: candidate − the served component, basin-pooled, rain known

parts.reason: its T2 is development (selection-contaminated): its choices were not made nested (protocol §2), so T2 cannot confirm it
the 90% CI's upper bound is below 5% of the incumbent's BS on the same rows

rows.caveat: post_seen (protocol §2): its training record (the older SFPUC reports from 2011, every discharge day) was chosen in OLDER_REPORTS.md with the older-report sets' post-training scores in view

rows.label: S2 South floor (Part B 7)
rows.comparison: South's S2 BSS against its climatology
rows.rule: the lower bound of the 90% CI is above 0

rows.label: S2 volume (Part B 7)
rows.comparison: declared head vs the pre-registered fallback
rows.rule: Fallback: when a basin has fewer than 20 known-volume events, a pooled Bay-side log-linear volume model with a basin offset. The build fails only if no declared fallback exists.
rows.reason: an existing GEO_V1 set shares the served bundle's volume heads, refit per fold by stages_s2 under the 20-event floor; the declared fallback is a stage candidate's (P8f)

rows.label: S3a geography
rows.comparison: East-zone Brier, SFPUC4 vs GEO_V1, with S4 held fixed
rows.rule: non-inferiority at +5% of the GEO_V1 BS. SFPUC4 fixes a listed defect: Islais was in the wrong basin, so Candlestick was mis-forecast.
rows.reason: the candidate is the served set's geography: S3a compares geographies

rows.label: S3b
rows.comparison: Westside share s(v̂) vs a constant share
rows.reason: no Westside share model with a size term to test (S3b reads a stage candidate's s(v̂) and its constant benchmark, stages_s3_links)

rows.label: S4
rows.comparison: S4 v3 vs the served table (GEO_V1 adapter), zone-pooled ΔBS on first-look samples
rows.rule: superiority, or non-inferiority at +5% plus a fix for the oracle-worse-than-chained defect. The Candlestick-station sensitivity score is reported beside it (A2).
rows.reason: the §8 S4 row tests S4 v3 (zone_v3) against the served table; the candidate's S4 is impact_v1 (impact_v2_adapter), which no §8 row scores

rows.label: S5
rows.entry: oracle (perfect feed, no sibling rows) and chained (degraded feed: 13% missed, 60% one day late, 5 seeds)
rows.reason: its S5 is the served set's (live_v2), so this row decides nothing for it (protocol §9.1 reads changed components); computed: fail — computed by stages_s5 on this build (basin_swap = live_v2 exists on GEO_V1's basins only)

parts.reason: superiority on every seed: the highest seed's upper bound below 0 (the range runs from the lowest seed's lower bound to the highest's upper)

rows.label: OUT
rows.comparison: candidate set vs served, zone-pooled ΔBS
rows.rule: non-inferiority at +5%, and pooled MCB not worse beyond its CI
rows.reason: zone-pooled; T0 (prospective, from 2026-10-03) holds no scored day: the data end (2026-08-17) is before it, so T1 post-training stands alone

parts.reason: the 90% CI's upper bound is below 5% of the served set's BS on the same rows
pooled MCB not worse beyond its CI
the 90% CI's upper bound is not below 5% of the served set's BS on the same rows

promotion.rule: protocol §9: a candidate replaces the served set only when all five hold
promotion.note: Each criterion is stated as met, not met or not yet computable, with its reason. This block decides nothing: replacing the served set is the owner's action (§9), and nothing on this branch changes served.json or what the live forecast computes.

criteria.criterion: Each changed component passes its own-stage primary (§8) on T2, nested for new choices.
criteria.reason: s2: S2 fail; s3: no §8 primary scores this change; s4: no §8 primary scores this change. Caveats: S2: post_seen (protocol §2): its training record (the older SFPUC reports from 2011, every discharge day) was chosen in OLDER_REPORTS.md with the older-report sets' post-training scores in view

criteria.criterion: OUT is non-inferior at the +5% margin on T1 post ∪ T0, for rain known and for lead 1. Any bias in these windows favours the incumbent.
criteria.reason: non-inferiority at +5%, rain known: pass; non-inferiority at +5%, lead 1: fail.
